g.text: RTP Status Update Cancel Flow (sync) — POST /rtps/status-update/cancel
[OAUTH2] oauth2 field present in TSP config
retry up to 3 times (backoff) only if Sidecar is unreachable
The RTP resourceId is used for both path params:
the RfC is identified by the client-assigned RTP id
RFC_NOT_RECEIVED event recorded in the RTP history
[NO TRANSITION] 200 with reason RCPR, or no reason
State unchanged, nothing written to the DB.
RCPR → RfC already received and processed by the SP
No reason (empty body or {}) → outcome comes later
- Reason AEXR / RCAR (Final states saved to ADX & deleted from MONGO)
- Reason RCNR (RFC_SENT kept, RFC_NOT_RECEIVED event saved to MONGO)
- Reason RCPR or no reason (No transition / async callback)
- Service Provider invalid response (Unknown reason / Non-conformant response)
[500 Internal Server Error] Server Error Cases
[SP NOT FOUND] Provider not in registry
Provider not found in Service Registry
[INVALID STATE] RTP not in state RFC_SENT
Invalid status transition: no RfC pending for this RTP.
No call is made to the Service Provider
